effect_description_eng:
[Trash] [End of Your Turn] If you have 4 or fewer cards in your hand, 1 of your [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] Delete all of your opponent's lowest level Digimon.
